config.title: Manage plugin and AI settings

setup.title: First time setup: set an admin password
setup.desc: Managing configuration involves local files. We've prepared a recommended password you can use as-is or change.
setup.passwordPlaceholder: Enter or use the recommended password

login.title: Admin verification required
login.desc: Managing configuration involves local files and requires an admin password.

config.errorConflict: An admin password was already set. Please log in.
config.passwordHint: Forgot or want to change the password? Edit the password field in the config file above (or delete it), save, and refresh this page to set it again.

update.title: Application Update
update.desc: Check for updates, then download, verify and install in-app. The app restarts automatically.
update.devBuild: This is a development build. You can still install a newer release.
update.restartTimeout: The update was installed but the app did not come back in time. Please restart it manually.

mcp.title: MCP Settings
mcp.desc: MCP (Model Context Protocol) uses a separate long-lived token, independent of the login credentials.
mcp.tokenPlaceholder: Leave empty to disable MCP token auth
mcp.emptyHint: When empty: MCP is fully open. With -auth enabled, a token is generated automatically on startup. Changes take effect immediately, no restart needed.
mcp.cardNoTokenHint: No MCP token configured, so the MCP endpoint is open. Configure a token in Settings, or start with -auth to generate one automatically.
mcp.tokenLockedHint: The MCP token requires the management password. Unlock it in Settings, then come back to this page.

cluster.title: Remote Nodes
cluster.desc: Manage slave nodes connected to this master. Their devices are aggregated into this master.
cluster.httpWarning: HTTP exposes Basic Auth login details in plaintext. HTTPS is recommended in production.
cluster.directSetupHint: Start the slave as a normal server and make sure the master can reach this URL.
cluster.directSetupUrlHint: The master will connect to this slave via {url}.
cluster.editDirectDesc: Update the slave URL or Basic Auth credentials. Leave the password empty to keep it unchanged.
cluster.tokenHint: Copy and configure it on the slave now; it cannot be viewed again.
cluster.rotateConfirm: Rotate the token for {name}? The existing connection will be closed immediately.
cluster.deleteConfirm: Delete node {name}? Its devices will be removed from the list.
cluster.credentialsOptionalHint: Leave username and password empty if the slave has no authentication.
cluster.includeNestedHint: Also aggregate devices from nodes this slave is connected to (off by default to avoid duplicates and cycles)
cluster.modeDesktopHint: The desktop app only listens on localhost, so remote nodes cannot dial in; only master direct mode is available

ai.title: OpenAI Configuration
ai.desc: Configure the OpenAI-compatible API base URL, key, and model for AI features.

jev.title: Jev Configuration
jev.desc: Configure the Jev (TypeSafe System One) decision endpoint, key, and model for plugins.

plugin.installDesc: Upload a .zip archive to extract and install to the user plugin directory.
plugin.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall plugin "{name}"? This deletes the plugin directory and cannot be undone.
plugin.marketDesc: Browse plugins from the market source and install or update with one click.
plugin.marketUnavailable: The plugin market is under maintenance. Please try again later.

screen.encoderUnsupported: No usable video encoder. Switch to another encoder, or use HTTPS.

encoderDialog.title: Video encoder
encoderDialog.description: Choose the video encoder scrcpy uses for this device.
encoderDialog.autoDescription: Let the app pick an encoder.
encoderDialog.baselineDescription: The software decoder (TinyH264) requires Baseline; some hardware encoders don't support it. Turn it off to retry.

presence.busyDesc: You can wait, observe, or take it over.
presence.freeHint: The device is released automatically after the idle timeout.
presence.readOnlyDesc: You can watch the screen but cannot control the device.

access.title: Access & Presence
access.desc: Configure trusted proxy identity and device occupancy behavior.
access.trustedProxiesHint: One IP or CIDR per line. X-Forwarded-* headers are honored only for requests from these addresses.
access.signoutUrlHint: Optional, e.g. /oauth2/sign_out. Leave empty to hide the sign-out action.
access.requireIdentityWarning: Identity is required but no trusted proxy is configured: anonymous browsers cannot use the API. Edit config.json and restart to recover.
access.presenceEnabledHint: Track who controls each device and release idle devices automatically.
access.allowObserversHint: Other users can watch the screen and read the UI tree in read-only mode.
